mapper.insert: INSERT INTO b_portal_list ( gmt_create, gmt_modify, type_id, name, gender, birthday, passport, english_score, completion_date, visa_expiration_date, exam_results_date, student_visa_expiration_date, has_completion_letter, json_str, contract_str, adviser_id, official_id, mara_id, service_order_id, str_state) VALUES ( now(), now(), #{typeId}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{birthday}, #{passport}, #{englishScore}, #{completionDate}, #{visaExpirationDate}, #{examResultsDate}, #{studentVisaExpirationDate}, #{hasCompletionLetter}, #{jsonStr}, #{contractStr}, #{adviserId}, #{officialId}, #{maraId}, #{serviceOrderId}, #{strState});
mapper.select: SELECT id, gmt_create AS gmtCreate, gmt_modify AS gmtModify, type_id AS typeId, name, gender, birthday, passport, english_score AS englishScore, completion_date AS completionDate, visa_expiration_date AS visaExpirationDate, exam_results_date AS examResultsDate, student_visa_expiration_date AS studentVisaExpirationDate, has_completion_letter AS hasCompletionLetter, json_str AS jsonStr, contract_str AS contractStr, ai_consult_content AS aiConsultContent, adviser_id AS adviserId, official_id AS officialId, mara_id AS maraId, service_order_id AS serviceOrderId, str_state AS strState FROM b_portal_list WHERE type_id = #{typeId, jdbcType=INTEGER} AND name = #{name} LIMIT 1;
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM b_portal_list WHERE id = #{id, jdbcType=INTEGER}
